claims.claim: Presents specific source-supported content as a current or dated observation.

sources.quote: Effective 7 MAY 2026, SDF has consolidated its bug bounty programs into this single HackerOne program.

claims.claim: Makes the as-of date visible for every changeable roster, status, version, or measurement.
Treats deprecated general Immunefi and the independent OpenZeppelin bounty as distinct.

sources.quote: The Stellar ImmuneFi program at immunefi.com/bug-bounty/stellar is deprecated.
OpenZeppelin on Stellar — Reward amount is 10% of the funds directly affected up to a maximum of: $25,000
There are two Immunefi bounties supported by the Stellar Development Foundation.

claims.notes: HackerOne says the general Stellar Immunefi program is deprecated. The SDF landing page still says two Immunefi bounties are supported.

claims.claim: Treats third-party apps and Audit Bank as two other distinct scopes.

sources.quote: Vulnerabilities in third party applications that make use of Stellar’s API
Audit support available through the Audit Bank for eligible projects

claims.notes: The first source excludes third-party applications. The second describes audit support, not vulnerability reporting.
